title: Create web/index.html: a static page titled "Swarm status" with exactly one <h1>, a <main> landmark, and a <table id="tasks"> whose header cells are Task, Role, Status (in that order). No external scripts or stylesheets.
verify_cmd:
python -c 'import html.parser, pathlib
class P(html.parser.HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.tags = []; self.th = []; self.cur = None; self.title = ""; self.ext = 0; self.table = False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs); self.tags.append(tag); self.cur = tag
        if tag == "table" and a.get("id") == "tasks": self.table = True
        if tag == "script" and a.get("src"): self.ext += 1
        if tag == "link" and a.get("rel") == "stylesheet": self.ext += 1
    def handle_endtag(self, tag): self.cur = None
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.cur == "th": self.th.append(data.strip())
        if self.cur == "title": self.title += data
p = P(); p.feed(pathlib.Path("web/index.html").read_text())
assert p.title.strip() == "Swarm status", p.title
assert p.tags.count("h1") == 1 and "main" in p.tags and p.table
assert p.th == ["Task", "Role", "Status"], p.th
assert p.ext == 0'
